description: The colors of a group card from the tokens card, bg, edge and rule of its theme and mode, the level of its members (1 for a group card of the plane), whether the cards share one line at the seam and the chrome value group-fill-fade (fade) (docs/spec/groups.md#drawing): head is the color of its header, the color of the head of a content card; line is the line under its header, edge with a gap and rule at the seam, as under the head of a content card; body is the color of the area inside its frame around its members, bg mixed into card by fade to the power of the level, each channel rounded to the nearest integer and a half up.

cases.name: with a gap the header is a card head over the line edge, and the body of level 1 is bg mixed into card by fade
at the seam the line under the header is rule, as under the head of a card
each nesting level mixes bg into card by one more power of fade, so the body of level 2 stands nearer to card
the body of level 3 takes bg by fade to the power 3
the dark mode of a theme follows the same rule
a nested group card of the dark mode at the seam
a level of any depth takes its own power of fade, without a last level
a fade of 0 draws the body in card, as the body of a card
a fade of 1 draws the body in bg, the color of the stage
